Title: Apache HTTP Server Multiple Vulnerabilities
Solution: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.58 or later. Apply security patches and restart the service.
Results: Apache/2.4.41 Server detected. Multiple critical vulnerabilities found in this version. Vulnerable to remote code execution and denial of service attacks.

Title: SSL Certificate Signed Using Weak Hashing Algorithm
Solution: Replace the SSL certificate with one signed using SHA-256 or stronger algorithm.
Results: SSL certificate is signed using SHA-1 algorithm which is considered weak. Certificate expires on 2024-06-15.

Title: SSH Weak Encryption Algorithms Enabled
Solution: Configure SSH to disable weak encryption algorithms. Update sshd_config file.
Results: SSH server supports weak encryption algorithms: 3des-cbc, aes128-cbc

Title: Microsoft SQL Server Multiple Vulnerabilities
Solution: Apply SQL Server 2019 CU25 or later. Install latest security updates.
Results: SQL Server 2019 CU22 detected. Multiple critical vulnerabilities allow remote code execution.

Title: Windows SMB Signing Not Required
Solution: Enable SMB signing requirement in Group Policy or registry settings.
Results: SMB signing is not required, allowing potential man-in-the-middle attacks.

Title: Windows RDP Security Layer Not Set to SSL
Solution: Configure RDP to use SSL/TLS encryption for enhanced security.
Results: RDP is configured to use RDP security layer instead of SSL/TLS.

Title: Samba Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
Solution: Upgrade Samba to version 4.18.8 or later. Apply available security patches.
Results: Samba 4.17.5 detected. Vulnerable to remote code execution via crafted packets.

Title: NFS Exported Share Information Disclosure
Solution: Restrict NFS share permissions and implement proper access controls.
Results: NFS shares are exported with world-readable permissions: /home, /data

Title: Adobe Acrobat Multiple Vulnerabilities
Solution: Update Adobe Acrobat to the latest version. Enable automatic updates.
Results: Adobe Acrobat Reader 2023.006.20320 detected with multiple vulnerabilities allowing arbitrary code execution.

Title: Google Chrome Multiple Vulnerabilities
Solution: Update Google Chrome to version 121.0.6167.85 or later.
Results: Google Chrome 120.0.6099.216 detected with multiple high-severity vulnerabilities.
